title: Brief me on a topic
description: Pull together everything your files and notes say about something.
prompt: Brief me on {topic}. Search my memory thoroughly and give me a short, skimmable briefing: key facts first, then open questions. Cite sources.

title: Plan my week
description: Turn your goals into a realistic to-do list.

fields.name: goals
fields.label: What do you want to get done?

prompt: Help me plan my week. My goals: {goals}. Check the date, look at my existing to-dos, then add the most important new to-dos (at most 5) and give me a simple day-by-day plan.

title: Draft a reply
description: Write an email draft using what's in your notes. Nothing is sent.

fields.name: about
fields.label: What should it say?
fields.placeholder: ask to fix the heater before Friday

prompt: Draft an email to {to} about: {about}. Check my notes for relevant facts and my usual tone first, then save it as a draft.

title: Explain it simply
description: Find a document in your memory and explain it like you're 12.
prompt: Find what my memory has about {doc}, read the most relevant document, and explain it in plain language a 12-year-old would understand. List anything important I should watch out for.

title: Summarize a web page
description: Paste a link and get the gist in 5 bullets.
prompt: Read {url} and summarize it in 5 short bullets. Then tell me if it relates to anything in my memory.

title: Remember something
description: Tell ReWoo a fact about you. It asks before saving.
